## Fixed
- Spotify songs no longer stop with "This video cannot be embedded". Many labels switch off playing their videos outside YouTube. The server now only picks videos that may be played in the app, and if one still refuses, the app quietly takes the next best one for the same song instead of skipping it
- The same for songs found on YouTube Music
- Old remembered videos are looked up again once, so earlier blocked ones are replaced

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates, or install the new `Musik.apk` over the old one
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
